scientific_integrity: The stated finite theorem is supported by complete deterministic state enumeration via two independent functional-graph algorithms and an exhaustive 120-action symmetry classification; no infinite-family inference or independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the ten-vertex triangular graph with three colors and threshold-one synchronous updates is classified.
No priority claim against unindexed historical finite tables is certified.

title: Complementary Petersen dynamics: matched excitation basins and 118 geometric wave classes on the triangular graph
